properties.description: Two test files, four cases (the fourth pins the floor of six from both sides). The core file checks unlinked_intent and its unlinked_intent gap finding. capture_offers_what_a_new_requirement_relates_to, in the second test artifact, checks that the served capture-intent skill calls relation_candidates on a new requirement and puts the candidates to the person. Measured 2026-10-08 on reflow2's own design: 134 of 890 requirements and accepted decisions relate to no other intent. Not covered: whether the person acts on the offers. That is behaviour in a session, which no test here can see.
properties.name: Requirements and accepted decisions linked to no other intent are noticed, and capture-intent offers a new requirement's relations
